title: A dual-fluorescence approach for turn-on ammonia and turn-off explosive picric acid detection via ESIPT inhibition: experimental, theoretical, and biological studies
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,32894-32905
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA05068E, Paper
Open Access

Malavika S. Kumar, Avijit Kumar Das
A fluorescent naphthalene–anthracene dyad (AMN) was developed as a dual-mode sensor for turn-on detection of ammonia (NH3) and turn-off detection of picric acid (PA).
